polls.note: After Laššáková withdrawal; Lešková still included (withdrew 13.10). n=250 -> MoE ~±7-8 pp on decided base (~164). presovak.sk quoted 44.8 % for Majerský citing the same AKO/JOJ poll – discrepancy unresolved.

key_events.text: 11 candidates filed, the most of any region; Majerský backed by KDH, Hnutie Slovensko, SaS, Za ľudí, Konzervatívci, PS.
Smer MEP Judita Laššáková withdrew after agreement with Smer leadership (Fico: 'to make the race realistic'); Smer had said in August it might withdraw her to back Mazurek against Majerský.
Zoltán Kašo (Tím Košice) withdrew and endorsed Samuel Migaľ.
Monika Lešková (SNS) withdrew on STVR debate, SNS support to Milan Mazurek; Mazurek attacked Majerský's management of regional finances in the debate.
AKO/JOJ 24 poll published: Majerský 49.2 %, Mazurek 32.4 %, Migaľ 7.8 % (decided, n=250).

notes: Effective field 8 (Čureja, Geci, Goliaš, Ištok, Majerský, Mazurek, Migaľ, Stanko); Kašo, Laššáková, Lešková remain on ballot but votes not counted. Consolidation of nationalist/government vote toward Mazurek (SNS endorsement, Smer withdrawal) is the main risk to Majerský; 2022 Kaliňák (Hlas+Smer) got 31.4 % + Mazurek 10.9 % = 42.3 % vs Majerský 42.0 %, so a fully consolidated anti-Majerský vote would be competitive – but Migaľ (sitting government minister running as independent) splits it. Bookmakers still price Majerský ~1.11-1.13. Ballot numbers follow MV SR/STVR list order (alphabetical); official PSK PDF not parsed.

candidates_2026.name: Ing. Rastislav Trnka
candidates_2026.profile: Incumbent since 2017, now independent; indicted in 'Valentín' procurement case (Tatra vehicles/sprinklers), trial moved to Okresný súd Námestovo by Supreme Court on 2026-01-29; denies guilt.

polls.note: Published ~2026-10-19/20 (article id 1274835); fieldwork dates and n not found in article text; Géci still listed (withdrew 12.10), so fieldwork likely overlapped early-mid October.
Only Trnka figure reported (lead >40 pp over others then announced). Before candidate lists were final.

key_events.text: Supreme Court moved Trnka's 'Valentín' procurement case from Košice courts to Okresný súd Námestovo; indictment pending >1 year, Trnka denies guilt.
Tipsport, Niké and Fortuna made Porvažník favourite (1.65-1.67) over Trnka (2.1-2.2) after Gurbáľová (KDH) and Hirman (Demokrati) stood aside for Porvažník.
Tibor Géci (Jednota Slovanov) withdrew/candidacy revoked; endorsed Igor Šimko.
Odds flipped back: Trnka narrow favourite (Fortuna 1.65 vs Porvažník 2.00); by 2026-10-20 Tipsport 1.75/1.95, Fortuna 1.80/1.90.
AKO/JOJ 24 poll: Trnka 42.4 %, Porvažník 25.7 %, Šimko 19.7 %, Soročinová 9.0 % (decided); 25.6 % undecided.

notes: Most competitive of the four. Effective field 5 (Kodrazi, Porvažník, Soročinová, Šimko, Trnka); Géci stays on ballot, votes not counted. Polls (AKO: Trnka +16.7 pp) and bookmakers (near coin-flip, Trnka 1.65-1.80 vs Porvažník 1.90-1.95) diverge strongly. Trnka draws cross-camp support (in AKO leads among SNS, Aliancia, Sme rodina, KDH, Hlas voters; strong in Trebišov, Spišská Nová Ves, Gelnica and among Hungarians); Porvažník leads in Košice I/II and Rožňava and among university-educated. Trnka won 2022 with KDH+Aliancia backing that he no longer has formally (KDH now backs Porvažník). Fortuna specials (2026-10-20): 'who gets higher %' Trnka 2.05 vs Becík (NR) 1.60; Porvažník 1.75 vs Mazurek 1.90. Ballot numbers follow MV SR/STVR list order (alphabetical); official KSK PDF (static.kosice.sk link) not parsed. The STVR table did not flag Géci's withdrawal with X in all views – rely on news/KSK notice.
